gloss: business trip expenses; travel expenses for work

definitions.gloss: business trip expenses; travel expenses for work
definitions.explanation: The total costs incurred when traveling for work, including transportation, accommodation, and daily allowances.

examples.japanese: {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}を{申請|しんせい}する。
examples.english: To submit a claim for business trip expenses.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{出張費|しゅっちょうひ}は{予算|よさん}を{超|こ}えてしまった。
examples.english: This month's business trip expenses went over budget.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{規定|きてい}では、{出張費|しゅっちょうひ}は{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}を{添|そ}えて{一週間以内|いっしゅうかんいない}に{精算|せいさん}することになっている。
examples.english: According to company policy, business trip expenses must be settled within one week with receipts attached.

notes:
A compound of {出張|しゅっちょう} (business trip) and {費|ひ} (expense; cost). Covers all costs associated with a business trip, including transportation ({交通費|こうつうひ}), accommodation ({宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}), and per diem allowances ({日当|にっとう}). A standard term in Japanese workplace vocabulary, commonly appearing on expense reports and reimbursement forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}を{精算|せいさん}する: to settle business trip expenses
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}を{申請|しんせい}する: to file for business trip expenses
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}の{上限|じょうげん}: expense limit for business trips
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}{規定|きてい}: business trip expense policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交通費|こうつうひ}: transportation costs — a subcategory covering only travel fares
- {旅費|りょひ}: travel expenses — a more general term that can apply to both business and personal travel
- {経費|けいひ}: expenses — a broader business term covering all operational costs
